title: Is a Fun, Therapeutic Game Possible?

thesis: The episode explores the intersection of bio and gaming, discussing whether games can be both fun and therapeutic while addressing the 'healthy dessert problem' of building games that satisfy both needs. The speakers define games as activities organized around three core principles: motivation, mastery, and feedback, and they discuss the shift in life sciences from empirical discovery to an iterative design process.
